audit.why: Eulogy of the Isles is 160s at rank 1, so the Maiden that flips the lane exists for a fraction of it. The packet chart reads Aatrox for six stages and Yorick only at Two+ items. 50.54% over 2228 games.

audit.why: The spikes and mid now carry Last Rites at 6s, Mourning Mist at 12s and the 160s Eulogy of the Isles, applied since my first read. The 160s number in particular is what makes 'survive one Maiden' actionable, and the spike ordering (pre-Maiden all-in, level 6, first item, late split) was already correct.

audit.whatIsWrong: Nothing anywhere explains where the ghouls come from. Last Rites digs a grave whenever it hits a champion or a large monster, or whenever its target dies — and Shepherd of Souls raises Mist Walkers from those graves. So every Last Rites Yorick lands on YOU is another ghoul, which means his swarm is fed by the trades he wins, not just by the wave. The full-layer tldr also still reads 'Yorick E, W cage, ghouls, and Maiden' rather than naming anything.
audit.why: Riot's text: Last Rites — 'Yorick deals bonus damage on his next attack and heals himself. If the target is a champion or large monster or if the target dies, a grave will be dug'; Shepherd of Souls — 'Yorick can summon Mist Walkers to swarm and attack nearby enemies.' That connection reframes the lane: dodging the 6s Last Rites is not just about the heal, it is about denying the grave that becomes the next ghoul. Mourning Mist then marks you and every summoned unit gains move speed toward the mark, which is the actual gank-and-swarm trigger.
audit.corrected: Grave-from-Last-Rites connection stated in mid; the full tldr rewritten around Mourning Mist, the destructible Dark Procession and the 160s Maiden.

audit.whatIsWrong: wants.foe[2] says he 'W-cages you out of the trade' as though Dark Procession is inescapable.
audit.why: Riot's text: 'Yorick summons a destructible wall at target location that will block enemy movement.' It is destructible — breaking one segment is faster than waiting it out, and the entry now says so in spikes[2] and early but not here.
audit.corrected: wants.foe[2] rewritten to name Dark Procession and its destructibility implicitly by naming the ability.

edits.before: From 3 you can all-in through the thin ghoul wall: land the full Q pattern with the sweetspot knockup and drain the trade back before Maiden exists. At 4-5 you keep the edge as long as you fight before he stacks graves, and dodging Mourning Mist keeps the swarm off you entirely. At 6, Eulogy of the Isles is a 160s cooldown at rank 1 — survive one Maiden and the window before the next is yours to kill him in.
edits.after: From 3 you can all-in through the thin ghoul wall: land the full Q pattern with the sweetspot knockup and drain the trade back before Maiden exists. Every Last Rites (6s) he lands on you digs a grave, and graves become his next ghouls — so dodging it starves the swarm as well as the heal. At 6, Eulogy of the Isles is 160s at rank 1: survive one Maiden and the window after it is yours to kill him in.

edits.before: Poke you down with ghouls and W-cage you out of the trade
edits.after: Cage you inside Dark Procession while the ghouls chew

edits.before: Levels 4-5 stay yours if you fight before he stacks graves and walls you off.
edits.after: Levels 4-5 stay yours if you dodge Last Rites so no grave is dug for him.

edits.before: Yorick changes the lane by forcing Aatrox to respect Yorick E, W cage, ghouls, and Maiden. Aatrox wins by controlling spacing with his first two Q swings, holding E until the enemy punish tool is committed, and managing the wave so the enemy must walk into the outer edge of his Q. Yorick wants to force long trades, punish overextension, and turn one bad Aatrox cooldown into a lane-losing fight.
edits.after: Yorick changes the lane by forcing Aatrox to respect Mourning Mist (E, 12s), whose mark speeds every ghoul toward him, and Last Rites (6s), which digs the grave that becomes the next Mist Walker. Aatrox wins by all-inning before Eulogy of the Isles exists, breaking a segment of the destructible Dark Procession rather than dying inside it, and killing him in the 160s after one Maiden.
